description: Trigger precision eval for safe-class-rename skill. Tests correct activation on class rename/refactor-name queries, and correct rejection of general refactoring, code generation, and impact analysis queries.

cases.query: AEnemy를 ABaseEnemy로 이름 변경해야 하는데, BP_Goblin이랑 BP_Skeleton이 AEnemy를 상속받고 있어. CoreRedirects 넣어주고 Blueprint 참조도 안전하게 업데이트해줘
cases.reason: Class rename with specific child BPs and CoreRedirects + BP reference safety concern

cases.query: rename APlayerCharacter to AHeroCharacter. it's in Source/MyGame/Characters/ and there are like 5 BPs inheriting from it plus a bunch of cast nodes in other BPs. need to make sure nothing breaks
cases.reason: English class rename with source path, known BP dependencies, and safety requirement

cases.query: AWeapon을 ABaseWeapon으로 safe rename하고 싶은데, AWeapon이 Source/MyGame/Weapons/Weapon.h에 있고, AWeaponMelee, AWeaponRanged가 상속 중이야. Redirector 자동으로 해줄 수 있어?
cases.reason: Safe rename with file path, known subclasses, and redirector automation question

cases.query: UHealthComponent라는 이름이 다른 플러그인이랑 겹쳐서 UCUHealthComponent로 리네임해야 해. CU prefix 규칙 때문인데, BP_Player랑 BP_Enemy에서 이 컴포넌트 쓰고 있어
cases.reason: CU prefix migration rename with naming collision context and BP usage

cases.query: refactor class name AProjectile to ABaseProjectile. we have AProjectileBullet, AProjectileRocket, AProjectileGrenade inheriting from it. also need CoreRedirects for any serialized references
cases.reason: Class name refactor with 3 specific subclasses and serialization concern

cases.query: AItem 클래스 이름을 좀 더 명확하게 바꾸고 싶은데, APickupItem으로 변경하면 돼. 근데 BP_HealthPack, BP_AmmoBox, BP_WeaponPickup이 전부 AItem 상속이라 안전하게 해줘야 해
cases.reason: Rename with 3 inheriting BPs explicitly named — safety-first rename

cases.query: AMonster 클래스를 ACreature로 리네임해야 하는데, 팀에서 디자인 변경으로 몬스터뿐만 아니라 NPC까지 포함하는 베이스 클래스로 쓰기로 했거든. Source/MyGame/AI/Monster.h 파일명도 같이 바꿔줘
cases.reason: Class rename with design rationale, file rename request, and expanded scope context

cases.query: UInventoryComponent 이름을 UCUInventoryComponent로 변경해야 해. Issue #5915 CU prefix 규칙 적용이야. GetInventory(), AddItem() 같은 함수에서 참조하는 곳도 전부 업데이트 필요해
cases.reason: CU prefix migration with specific issue reference and function reference update scope

cases.query: rename AMyPawn to ACUBasePawn safely. i know there are at least 3 BPs using it and some C++ files in Source/Combat/ that cast to AMyPawn. can you check all references before renaming and set up CoreRedirects?
cases.reason: Safe rename with pre-rename reference check request and CoreRedirects setup

cases.query: ACharacterBase 클래스명을 ACharacterCore로 바꿔야 하는데, 이 클래스가 모듈 경계를 넘어서 GameCore 모듈이랑 GamePlay 모듈 양쪽에서 참조되고 있어. Build.cs 의존성도 확인하면서 리네임해줘
cases.reason: Cross-module rename with Build.cs dependency concern and two specific module names

cases.query: 함수 추출해줘 BeginPlay에서
cases.reason: Method extraction — belongs to ue-cpp-refactor skill (extract method)

cases.reason: Impact analysis — belongs to ue-impact skill

cases.query: ACharacter의 callers 찾아줘
cases.reason: Caller graph query — belongs to caller-graph-visualizer or ue_analyze_symbols

cases.query: 프로젝트 리팩터링 전략 제안해줘
